title: Halcyon, which uses AI to aggregate documents from public utility commissions, energy regulators, and more, raised a $21M Series A led by Energize Capital (Katie Fehrenbacher/Axios)
summary: Katie Fehrenbacher / Axios: Halcyon, which uses AI to aggregate documents from public utility commissions, energy regulators, and more, raised a $21M Series A led by Energize Capital — Halcyon, an AI energy data startup, closed a $21 million Series A round to build out its product and expand its team, CEO and co-founder Bruce Falck tells Axios Pro exclusive…
